question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

They have also tested fully (autonomous) landings and semi - autonomous take - offs for the gas - powered rotorcraft.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Independent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about testing fully independent landings and semi-autonomous take-offs.
 
• "**Autonomous**" means having the ability to act independently. (स्वतंत्र रूप से कार्य करने की क्षमता होना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The autonomous car navigated through traffic without human intervention.*
 
 
 
• Marked option "**Independent**" means not relying on others. (दूसरों पर निर्भर नहीं रहना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She moved into her own apartment, becoming financially independent from her parents.*
 
 
 
• The word "fully" emphasizes that the landings were completely independent, while the take-offs were only partially independent.
 
• So, the synonym for "autonomous" is "independent".

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Occlude **means to block or obstruct. (रोक देना)
 
• **Obstruct **means to block or hinder. (बाड़ डालना)
 
• **Unanimous **means in agreement or united. (सर्व-सम्मत)
